name: Thunder Fang

specialAbility.name: Static Shock
specialAbility.description: Thunder Fang charges up its electric fangs and zaps the enemy with a crackling bolt of lightning!

lore: During the wildest thunderstorm anyone had ever seen, a bolt of lightning struck the junkyard and Thunder Fang was born! This yellow-and-orange beast has electric fangs on its grill and lightning bolts crackling across its body. Touch it and you will get the shock of your life!
